title: Priestley Representation of Distributive Precontact Lattices
summary: It is well known that, in Boolean algebras, the notions of precontact relation, quasi-modal operator, and subordination relation are interdefinable. In contrast, within the setting of distributive lattices, this equivalence holds only between quasi-modal operators and subordination relations, but not with precontact relations. In this paper, we study the class of bounded distributive lattices equipped with a precontact relation, referred to as precontact lattices.
